verdict.why: Left has a readable roof with overhanging eaves and stone-slab tiling, a two-tone palette (dark wood walls, grey stone, mossy cobble) and a grounded terrain base, so it reads as a house with character from the street. Right's roof is a stair-stepped brown lid that flattens into one dark mass across all four views, with low material contrast and a stone plinth that looks like a bare platform rather than a built base.
